is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.l. mosquitoes collected from breeding sites in Benin (Page 1, Abstract; Page 2, Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Assays the Ace-1 G119S (G280S) mutation using PCR-RFLP (Page 2, Methods; Page 4, Table 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 (Page 4) provides counts of RR, RS, and SS genotypes for the Ace-1 G119S mutation for Anopheles gambiae s.s. from Kandi (N=48: 0 RR, 0 RS, 48 SS) and Malanville (N=48: 0 RR, 1 RS, 47 SS).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae and pupae were collected from field breeding sites in Ouemé, Atacora, and Alibori departments in Benin in 2012 and reared to adults (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical research paper presenting original bioassay and molecular marker data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Field sampling locations are specified at the district level: Seme, Tanguieta, Kandi, and Malanville districts in Benin (Page 2, Methods; Page 3, Figure 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Sampling took place during rainy seasons in 2012 (March-July and September-November 2012 in Seme; May to October 2012 in Tanguieta, Kandi, and Malanville) (Page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine new field collections conducted in 2012 by CREC in Benin.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype frequency and count data are presented in Table 2 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated organophosphate (fenitrothion) and carbamate (bendiocarb) susceptibility using CDC bottle bioassays and genotyped the Ace-1 G119S (G280S) target-site mutation in Anopheles gambiae s.s. collected in 2012 across four districts (Seme, Tanguieta, Kandi, Malanville) in Benin.
